coverage_scope: Delivery is not understanding. Repeated queries remain legal; scientific question/intent is not inferred.

method_scope.static_analysis: Constructs and checks operating points; local mathematical assumptions only. AnalysisRequest validates operation/point/window before workers.
method_scope.offline_nlp: Predicted tension trajectories and search starts; independent physics still required.
method_scope.nmpc: Optional closed-loop control and soft screening; numerical convergence, prediction and MuJoCo acceptance are separate. No verified model error bound means no structural hard veto. Cost is measured, not presumed low.
method_scope.response_search: Finite differences of full physical rollouts; local information near evaluated coefficients.
method_scope.pattern_search: Finite nongradient physical search; budget and full original acceptance remain authoritative.
method_scope.direct_ppo: Independent optional policy training, without an NMPC prerequisite; published policies require separate evaluation.
method_scope.residual_ppo: Requires a complete compatible reference, including failed-but-complete NMPC execution; predicted and measured references retain their origin.
